notes.subject: feat(agent): allow explicit background reasoning effort
notes.summary: spawn_background_agent accepts an explicit reasoningEffort for native background agents, overriding configured review and task defaults, with reasoning_effort kept as a legacy alias and ACP agents rejecting it.

notes.subject: fix(agent): reduce image-history memory allocation spikes
notes.summary: Reduces memory spikes in image-heavy chats by avoiding duplicate Codex history translation, rejecting oversized replay snapshots before serializing them, and loading background-agent images only in panes viewing that transcript.

notes.subject: fix(browser-gateway): recover stalled Ask Agent sends safely
notes.summary: Ask Agent sends now confirm delivery on acceptance, retry once with the same message ID if stalled, and keep the draft with a 'Delivery not confirmed' error instead of hanging on 'Sending…' or risking duplicate turns.

notes.subject: fix(workspace-host): recheck elapsed budget deadlines
notes.summary: Background agents no longer hit elapsed-time budget exhaustion early; the deadline is rechecked and the timer rescheduled if it fires before the hard limit.

notes.subject: fix(tools): close feedback gaps in terminal, question and image tools
notes.summary: Adds protected-Git retry guidance to get_terminal_output, accepts Yes/No for background yes_no questions, reports generate_image size/quality mismatches, limits delegated ownership to output_path, and allows /tmp images.
